scope: Three fresh one-hour worlds per gift rule, with the same random-founder sampler, complete configuration and observation tools. Matching seeds are not deterministic paired counterfactuals on the GPU. Groups contain at least four reciprocally linked cells; moving means centroid speed above two world units/second. Recent thrust means at least one member successfully applied nonzero thrust within the preceding 60 ticks. Neither motion nor thrust proves coordinated locomotion. Late means use seven snapshots at minutes 30–60; they are not continuous-time integrals. Gift syntax may be unreachable or ineffective. No epiplexity estimate is inferred.
